title: Identity builder
purpose: Build the artist's reusable on-screen identity once. Editing mints a version; adding evidence does not.

children.source: Version notice — kits already generated stay bound to the version that produced them
children.note: Losing the description a run was generated against makes that run unreproducible.

children.title: Description
children.hint: Text the generator receives before every shot prompt.

children.title: Composed prompt
children.hint: What a provider will actually receive, assembled from the fields on the left.

children.source: Contradiction check between the identity fragment and the shot prompt
children.note: A prompt that describes a face and then asks for an empty centre frame resolves as one or the other. Surfacing the assembled string is how that gets caught before it is bought.

children.title: Reference frames
children.hint: The image half of the identity. One frame per lighting setup, plus accepted stills.

children.caption: Reference frame — lighting setup, framing, content hash
children.note: The domain model carries these and nothing can currently create one. This is the surface that closes that gap.

children.message: No reference frames. The identity is text-only until frames are added.
